div.style: color: rgb(23, 32, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
1. You start VRTrunserver
on every participant machine

div.style: color: rgb(23, 32, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
2. You start VRTrun
on your computer

div.style: color: rgb(23, 32, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
3. Each machine gets its settings,
starts its sensors, then the player

div.style: color: rgb(23, 32, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
4. The session runs: sensors write
.jsonl files, the player writes stats.log

div.style: color: rgb(23, 32, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
5. The players close, the sensors stop,
and every file comes back to you

div.style: color: rgb(23, 32, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(23, 32, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;
